speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Citadel Summit reached. Elevation: five-thousand meters. Atmospheric containment failing. We are inside the Void Singularity Chamber—the heart of the Citadel and the seat of the Void Commander.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA: The cosmic radiation in this room is off the charts. Look at the event horizon... gravity itself is warping around the dais. Stand close behind my bulwark!

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: Thermal and energy telemetry confirmed. The Commander is draining the entire planetary geothermal grid straight into the singularity. He's preparing to purge the entire civilian population with one command.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: No Praetorian guards. No drone legions. No mechanized armies. Just him on that floating obsidian throne. He knew we were coming... and he's waiting for us.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Let him wait! We broke his tanks at the Aegis, flattened his labs in the Grave, and wrecked his fortress at the Bastion. That armored crown is coming off today.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: The psychic dissonance is deafening, but underneath it... I can hear the heartbeat of millions across the eleven liberated sectors below. They are singing for the dawn.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: VOICE OF THE VOID COMMANDER: 'You crawled out of the scrap heaps and broken alleys only to kneel before godhood. Your insurrection ends here. Axiom Force dies tonight.'

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Phase blades energized. Shields synchronized. Every hack, every duel, every scar brought us to this threshold. We finish this together.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Axiom Force! For every name stripped away, for every life stolen by the machine, for the liberation of the world—draw your weapons. Strike down the Commander!
